title: centaurium maritimum var. brevipes
intro: Centaurium maritimum var. brevipes, commonly known as mountain centaury, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the gentian family. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of mountain centaury include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
